issues.description: alloc_if_none assumes that a newly allocated page is fresh in the SPT frame map and then assumes the entire updated SubPageTable invariant.
issues.rationale: The function inserts a new child frame and permission into the SPT model, but the allocator contract at this revision does not guarantee that the returned address is absent from the old metadata/frame domains, and the raw permission value is inserted without the tracked ownership relation needed by SubPageTable::wf. The two assumptions therefore manufacture the freshness and global invariant required by the function's postconditions. Commit 6747158e strengthens PageTableNode::alloc with a non-membership guarantee and preservation facts, inserts the tracked permission, proves freshness, and replaces assume(spt.wf()) with assert(spt.wf()).
issues.source_evidence: after/lock-protocol/src/mm/page_table/node/entry.rs lines 434-438 assumes the new page address is absent from spt.frames; lines 481-485 insert the permission and assume the whole SPT invariant. Official repair 6747158e33ae6c85efbe0f7485cb3e614d9a9e51 adds allocator freshness/preservation guarantees, tracked-inserts the permission, and proves spt.wf().
issues.verification: Fixed-source invariant/ownership analysis and direct official repair diff. Historical Verus was not executed.
